title: Hurricane Mitch
description: One of the deadliest Atlantic hurricanes, devastating Central America.

title: Izmit Earthquake
description: A 7.6 magnitude earthquake in Turkey causing massive destruction.

title: SARS Outbreak
description: Severe acute respiratory syndrome outbreak begins to spread globally from Asia.

title: Indian Ocean Tsunami
description: A massive 9.1 magnitude earthquake triggers a devastating tsunami across the Indian Ocean.

title: Hurricane Katrina
description: Hurricane Katrina devastates New Orleans, disrupting US oil production and causing an energy shock.

title: Cyclone Nargis
description: A highly destructive cyclone that struck Myanmar, causing catastrophic damage.

title: Sichuan Earthquake
description: An 8.0 magnitude earthquake strikes Sichuan, China, causing massive loss of life.

title: H1N1 Swine Flu Pandemic
description: WHO declares H1N1 a global pandemic.

title: Haiti Earthquake
description: A catastrophic 7.0 magnitude earthquake in Haiti.

title: Eyjafjallajökull Eruption
description: Volcanic eruption in Iceland creates an ash cloud that grounds European flights for weeks.

title: Japan Earthquake, Tsunami, and Fukushima Nuclear Disaster
description: A 9.0 magnitude earthquake and tsunami hit Japan, causing a nuclear meltdown at Fukushima.

title: Hurricane Sandy
description: Superstorm Sandy hits the US East Coast, causing widespread damage and flooding.

title: Ebola Epidemic
description: WHO declares the West African Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.

title: Nepal Earthquake
description: A 7.8 magnitude earthquake strikes Nepal, causing massive destruction.

title: Hurricane Harvey
description: Category 4 hurricane hits Texas, causing unprecedented flooding and disrupting the US oil industry.

title: COVID-19 Initial Outbreak
description: Cases of severe atypical pneumonia are reported in Wuhan, China.

title: COVID-19 WHO Pandemic Declaration
description: WHO officially declares COVID-19 a global pandemic, triggering massive market selloffs.

title: COVID-19 Global Lockdowns
description: Unprecedented global lockdowns begin, freezing economic activity and prompting historic stimulus.

title: COVID-19 Vaccine Rollout Begins
description: Pfizer announces its vaccine is highly effective, sparking a massive risk-on market rally.

title: COVID-19 Variants Emergence
description: New highly transmissible variants (Alpha, and later Delta) renew concerns about prolonged pandemic.

title: Texas Power Freeze
description: Severe winter storm causes massive power grid failure in Texas, disrupting energy supplies.

title: Suez Canal Blockage
description: The Ever Given container ship blocks the Suez Canal, causing billions in global trade disruptions.

title: Global Supply Chain Crisis & Semiconductor Shortage
description: Post-pandemic demand surges clash with logistical bottlenecks and chip shortages, sparking major inflation.

title: Monkeypox (Mpox) Global Emergency
description: WHO declares the spreading monkeypox (mpox) outbreak a global health emergency.

title: Turkey-Syria Earthquake
description: A devastating 7.8 magnitude earthquake strikes southern Turkey and northern Syria.

title: Maui Wildfires
description: Devastating wildfires driven by high winds destroy the town of Lahaina in Hawaii.

title: Baltimore Bridge Collapse
description: Cargo ship destroys the Francis Scott Key Bridge, disrupting a major US port and supply chain routes.

title: Taiwan Earthquake
description: A 7.4 magnitude earthquake strikes Taiwan, raising temporary concerns over semiconductor supply chains.

title: Mpox Clade I Global Emergency
description: WHO declares Mpox a global health emergency again due to the spread of a deadlier variant in Africa.
